raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Legacy-collector txn_ts values look shifted +6h. Every batch spans 06:00 to 06:00 of recorded time, and batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19 02:00) holds timestamps up to 04:42 on 01-19, which is after its own ingest time. With a 6h correction the 14 batches map to 14 complete days (01-05 to 01-18), and the 36-row 01-19 stub disappears. The correction is inferred, not documented, and I assumed v2 timestamps are already correct, so confidence is moderate.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.5,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - (CASE WHEN collector = 'legacy' THEN INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE INTERVAL 0 HOUR END) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - (CASE WHEN collector = 'legacy' THEN INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE INTERVAL 0 HOUR END) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
